f.pu: To safeguard fossil deposits, mining sites, natural stratigraphic profiles or cuts and, in general, any interesting vestige of current and past geological and paleontological phenomena.
f.re: The following prohibitions apply: 1. Excavations and industrial or mining operations, unless there is a general interest and are expressly permitted by the competent authority; 2.
